editorial:
Imagine being a lonely twelve-year-old who just wants to fit in, and then suddenly you get the power to vanish into thin air. That is exactly what happens to Sue after she accidentally uses a potion made by her mom. The movie has a really lighthearted, magical feel to it that reminds you of those classic childhood adventure stories. You get to follow Sue as she moves from being a shy outsider to a brave leader. Along the way, she meets Tobi and App, two kids who quickly become her best friends and help her navigate the chaos of having a superpower while trying to save her parent.

What really makes this flick work is the chemistry between the kids and the funny moments that come from being invisible. The pacing is quick, and while the plot is pretty simple, it keeps you interested. Some of the special effects look a bit basic, but the heart of the story makes up for it. If you are looking for a cozy family night, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for the kids.
endingExplained: In the final act, Sue uses her invisibility to sneak into the villains' hideout without being spotted. With the help of Tobi and App, she manages to outsmart the criminals and free her mother. After a tense showdown, the bad guys are caught by the police. Sue realizes that her friendship with the other kids is more important than her powers. Everything wraps up happily with Sue feeling confident and no longer feeling like a lone wolf.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves magical adventures and stories about friendship.
